items.detail: Sydney Taylor hit a go-ahead 3-pointer to beat the defending champion Aces 84-83, became the first rookie in Sky franchise history to sink a 3 in the final five seconds of the fourth quarter or overtime.

items.headline: Source: WNBA won't discipline Bueckers, Reese
items.detail: WNBA stars Paige Bueckers and Angel Reese will not be disciplined for what appeared to be a friendly wager ahead of Wednesday's matchup, a league source told ESPN.

items.headline: Holmgren: OKC's departures were like losing family
items.detail: Oklahoma City's Chet Holmgren told reporters Saturday afternoon that the departures of three contributors to the Thunder's 2025 championship team felt "like losing a family member," but at the same time, "that's how the business of this game goes."

items.headline: Sources: Wemby lands signature shoe in Nike deal
items.detail: Spurs star Victor Wembanyama signed a new, long-term deal with Nike that includes a signature sneaker, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

items.headline: Game changers: How EA Sports made a video game the epicenter of soccer culture
items.detail: Long before the EAFC video game franchise nestled itself at the epicenter of soccer culture, FIFA International Soccer was an unexpected bestseller.

items.headline: Men's transfer grades: Chelsea get an A for Welbeck
items.detail: The 2026 summer transfer window is open. Here is how we rated the biggest deals.

items.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arteta to try to convince Vinícius Jr. to join Arsenal
items.detail: Mikel Arteta has tried to convince Real Madrid star Vinícius Júnior to join Arsenal. Transfer Talk has the latest.

items.headline: Braves bulk up staff, add Mahle, 31, from Giants
items.detail: The San Francisco Giants traded veteran pitcher Tyler Mahle, 31, to the Atlanta Braves, the clubs announced Sunday night, as the NL East's first-place team landed a 6-foot-3 right-hander who is 3-9 with a 5.13 ERA and 89 strikeouts this season.

items.headline: Rays acquire Peralta from Mets, bolster rotation
items.detail: The Rays acquired Freddy Peralta in a trade with the Mets in a move that gives Tampa Bay one of the AL's best rotations for the stretch run.

items.headline: Tawa's bunt try irks Guardians in perfect game bid
items.detail: After Arizona's Tim Tawa tried to bunt to break up a Cleveland perfect game bid on Sunday, Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo said it was a perfectly acceptable decision even though tensions boiled over in the Guardians' 5-0 victory at Progressive Field.
